title: The Sleeping Beauty
moral: Leave no one out. Being forgotten hurts.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본(docs/READ_MODE.md). text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. src=reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.pr:look:<stand|climb|reach|yawn|lie|wake: 공주. climb_stairs = 계단 네 칸 오르기(6장), prick = 물레에 손을 뻗어 콕!(별빛 한 점), wake = 반짝이며 일어나 앉기
acts.fairies:row[:<n>] | fairy:gift:<0-5> | p: 요정 여섯+막내 줄 세우기(2·11장) / i 번 요정이 걸어와 지팡이 반짝, 선물이 떠오름, 물러남(4장) / 금 접시 n개
acts.young:look:<stand|peek|wand> | young:at:: 막내 요정. hide = 커튼 뒤로 숨어 빼꼼, step_out = 커튼에서 나와 지팡이 반짝, sleep_all = 강아지·하녀·병사·요리사·꼬마를 차례로 재움(쿨쿨 팝)
acts.old:look:<stand|sulk|smile> | old:at:<x,: 잊힌 요정. enter = 문이 열리고 걸어 들어와 줄 끝에 섬 / 접시-요정 잇기 줄(한 줄씩, 수 세기 소리 없음)
acts.granny:look:<spin|startle> | granny:wigg: 물레 할머니·물레(덜컹 실려 나감)·실 세 가닥·탑 꼭대기 세트
acts.prince:look:<stand|tiptoe|kneel|wave>[:<: 왕자·할아버지. through = 열린 덤불 사이로 살금살금 들어가 사라짐
acts.sleepers:set | sleepers:wake | kitchen:s: 잠든 사람들(강아지·하녀·병사·요리사·꼬마) / 부엌 세트(선반 위 새, 탁자 아래 강아지, 요리사 옆 꼬마) / 촛불 / 침대
acts.bush:set | bush:grow | bush:open | tree:: 가시덤불 자람·열림 / 나무 커짐 / 해와 달이 여러 번 지나감 / 결혼식 세트(접시 여덟, 요정 여덟) / 종 딸랑

lines.text: 왕과 왕비는 오래오래 아기를 기다렸어요. 드디어 예쁜 공주님이 태어났어요!
lines.en: The king and queen waited a long, long time for a baby. At last, a lovely little princess was born!
segs: The king and queen waited a long, long time for a baby. At last, a lovely little princess was born!

lines.text: 성 안에서 왕이 기쁜 목소리로 말했어요.
lines.en: In the castle, the king spoke in a happy voice.
segs: In the castle, the king spoke in a happy voice.

lines.text: 온 나라 사람들을 불러 잔치를 열자!
lines.en: Let's invite the whole kingdom and hold a feast!
segs: Let's invite the whole kingdom and hold a feast!

lines.text: 요람이 흔들흔들, 방울이 딸랑딸랑 울렸어요.
lines.en: The cradle rocked to and fro, and the little bell went ting-a-ling.
segs: The cradle rocked to and fro, and the little bell went ting-a-ling.

lines.text: 아기는 까르르 웃었어요.
lines.en: The baby giggled, tee-hee!

lines.text: 왕비는 아기의 볼을 살살 쓰다듬으며 방긋 웃었어요.
lines.en: The queen gently stroked the baby's cheek, soft, soft, and smiled a sweet smile.
segs: The queen gently stroked the baby's cheek, soft, soft, and smiled a sweet smile.

lines.text: 잔칫날, 성 안 식탁에 손님 맞을 준비가 한창이었어요.
lines.en: On the feast day, the table in the castle was being set for the guests.
segs: On the feast day, the table in the castle was being set for the guests.

lines.text: 요정 일곱 명을 아기의 대모로 모셨어요. 금 접시도 일곱 개 놓았지요.
lines.en: Seven fairies were invited to be the baby's godmothers. Seven golden plates were set out for them.
segs: Seven fairies were invited to be the baby's godmothers. Seven golden plates were set out for them.

lines.text: 요정들은 알록달록 고운 옷을 입고 나란히 서 있었어요.
lines.en: The fairies stood side by side in their pretty dresses, every color of the rainbow.
segs: The fairies stood side by side in their pretty dresses, every color of the rainbow.

lines.text: 그런데 저기, 요정이 한 명 더 왔어요!
lines.en: But look, over there! One more fairy has come!
segs: But look, over there! One more fairy has come!

lines.text: 접시 하나에 요정 한 명씩 서자, 요정 한 명이 남았어요.
lines.en: One fairy stood by each plate, and one fairy was left over.
segs: One fairy stood by each plate, and one fairy was left over.

lines.text: 접시가 없는 요정은 누구일까요?
lines.en: Which fairy has no plate?

lines.text: 탑에 너무 오래 살아서 모두가 잊어버린 요정이었어요.
lines.en: It was the fairy who had lived in a tower so long that everyone had forgotten her.
segs: It was the fairy who had lived in a tower so long that everyone had forgotten her.

lines.text: 잔치 자리에 선 늙은 요정은 마음이 상했어요.
lines.en: Standing at the feast, the old fairy felt hurt.
segs: Standing at the feast, the old fairy felt hurt.

lines.text: 늙은 요정은 입을 삐죽 내밀고 접시를 두리번두리번 찾았어요.
lines.en: The old fairy pouted and looked all around, this way and that, for her plate.
segs: The old fairy pouted and looked all around, this way and that, for her plate.

lines.text: 내 접시는 없구나… 나만 빼놓다니.
lines.en: There is no plate for me... They left me out.
segs: There is no plate for me... They left me out.

lines.text: 어이쿠, 깜빡했어요. 미안해요.
lines.en: Oh dear, I forgot. I'm sorry.
segs: Oh dear, I forgot. I'm sorry.

lines.text: 막내 요정은 늙은 요정이 무슨 말을 할지 걱정됐어요.
lines.en: The youngest fairy worried about what the old fairy might say.
segs: The youngest fairy worried about what the old fairy might say.

lines.text: 막내 요정은 살금살금 커튼 뒤로 숨었어요.
lines.en: The youngest fairy tiptoed, creep, creep, and hid behind the curtain.
segs: The youngest fairy tiptoed, creep, creep, and hid behind the curtain.

lines.text: 나는 맨 나중에 말할래.
lines.en: I'll speak last.

lines.text: 같은 잔치 자리에서 여섯 요정이 아기 요람을 둘러쌌어요.
lines.en: At the feast, six fairies gathered around the baby’s cradle.
segs: At the feast, six fairies gathered around the baby’s cradle.

lines.text: 요정들이 한 명씩 다가와 지팡이를 반짝 흔들었어요.
lines.en: One by one the fairies came forward and waved their wands, twinkle, twinkle.
segs: One by one the fairies came forward and waved their wands, twinkle, twinkle.

lines.text: 예쁜 얼굴을 줄게.
lines.en: I give you a pretty face.
segs: I give you a pretty face.

lines.text: 상냥한 마음을 줄게.
lines.en: I give you a kind heart.
segs: I give you a kind heart.

lines.text: 고운 말씨를 줄게.
lines.en: I give you sweet words.

lines.text: 사뿐사뿐 춤을 줄게.
lines.en: I give you light, graceful dancing.
segs: I give you light, graceful dancing.

lines.text: 꾀꼬리 같은 노래를 줄게.
lines.en: I give you a song like a songbird.
segs: I give you a song like a songbird.

lines.text: 피리 솜씨를 줄게.
lines.en: I give you the gift of playing the flute.
segs: I give you the gift of playing the flute.

lines.text: 아기는 쌔근쌔근 웃었어요.
lines.en: The baby smiled softly in her sleep.
segs: The baby smiled softly in her sleep.

lines.text: 여섯 요정이 선물을 주자 늙은 요정이 아기에게 말했어요.
lines.en: After the six fairies gave their gifts, the old fairy spoke to the baby.
segs: After the six fairies gave their gifts, the old fairy spoke to the baby.

lines.text: 열여섯 살이 되면 물레 바늘에 찔려 영영 깨어나지 않는 깊은 잠에 빠질 거야.
lines.en: When she turns sixteen, she will prick her finger on a spindle and fall into a deep sleep from which she will never wake.
segs: When she turns sixteen, she will prick her finger on a spindle and fall into a deep sleep from which she will never wake.

lines.text: 왕과 왕비는 깜짝 놀라 부들부들 떨었어요.
lines.en: The king and queen gasped, and they trembled, shiver, shiver.
segs: The king and queen gasped, and they trembled, shiver, shiver.

lines.text: 그때 커튼 뒤에서 막내 요정이 나왔어요.
lines.en: Just then, the youngest fairy came out from behind the curtain.
segs: Just then, the youngest fairy came out from behind the curtain.

lines.text: 영영이 아니에요. 백 년이 지나면 깨어날 거예요. 그리고 왕자님이 올 거예요.
lines.en: Not never. After a hundred years she will wake up. And a prince will come.
segs: Not never. After a hundred years she will wake up. And a prince will come.

lines.text: 온 나라의 물레를 모두 치워라!
lines.en: Take away every spindle in the whole kingdom!
segs: Take away every spindle in the whole kingdom!

lines.text: 덜컹덜컹, 물레들이 수레에 실려 멀리멀리 떠났어요.
lines.en: Rattle, rattle! The spinning wheels were loaded onto carts and taken far, far away.
segs: Rattle, rattle! The spinning wheels were loaded onto carts and taken far, far away.

lines.text: 물레는 모두 사라졌어요.
lines.en: Every spindle was gone.

scenes.card: The Spinning Wheel in the Tower

lines.text: 공주님이 열여섯 살이 되던 날, 왕과 왕비는 멀리 나들이를 갔어요.
lines.en: On the day the princess turned sixteen, the king and queen went away on a journey.
segs: On the day the princess turned sixteen, the king and queen went away on a journey.

lines.text: 공주님은 성 구석구석을 돌아다니다 탑 꼭대기까지 올라갔어요.
lines.en: The princess wandered all around the castle, and climbed up to the very top of the tower.
segs: The princess wandered all around the castle, and climbed up to the very top of the tower.

lines.text: 계단은 빙글빙글, 끝없이 위로 이어졌어요.
lines.en: The stairs wound round and round, up and up, as if they would never end.
segs: The stairs wound round and round, up and up, as if they would never end.

lines.text: 탑 꼭대기 방에서는 할머니가 물레 앞에 앉아 있었어요.
lines.en: In the room at the top of the tower, an old woman sat at a spinning wheel.
segs: In the room at the top of the tower, an old woman sat at a spinning wheel.

lines.text: 할머니, 뭐 하세요?
lines.en: Grandma, what are you doing?

lines.text: 실을 잣고 있단다. 물레를 치우라는 말은 못 들었거든.
lines.en: I'm spinning thread, dear. Nobody told me the spindles had to go.
segs: I'm spinning thread, dear. Nobody told me the spindles had to go.

lines.text: 물레가 빙글빙글 돌고, 실이 길게 짧게 늘어졌어요.
lines.en: The spinning wheel whirred round and round, and threads hung down, some long, some short.
segs: The spinning wheel whirred round and round, and threads hung down, some long, some short.

lines.text: 물레를 구경하던 공주님이 할머니에게 말했어요.
lines.en: Watching the spinning wheel, the princess spoke to the old woman.
segs: Watching the spinning wheel, the princess spoke to the old woman.

lines.text: 저도 해 볼래요!
lines.en: Let me try too!

lines.text: 공주님이 손을 쑥 내민 순간, 바늘 끝이 손가락을 콕!
lines.en: The moment the princess reached out her hand, the tip of the spindle pricked her finger, prick!
segs: The moment the princess reached out her hand, the tip of the spindle pricked her finger, prick!

lines.text: 아야… 졸려요…
lines.en: Ouch... I'm so sleepy...

lines.text: 공주님은 눈을 감고 스르르 잠이 들었어요.
lines.en: The princess closed her eyes and drifted off to sleep.
segs: The princess closed her eyes and drifted off to sleep.

lines.text: 어머나, 큰일 났네! 누구 없어요?
lines.en: Oh my, oh dear! Is anybody there?
segs: Oh my, oh dear! Is anybody there?

lines.text: 왕과 왕비가 허둥지둥 달려왔어요.
lines.en: The king and queen came running, hurry-scurry.
segs: The king and queen came running, hurry-scurry.

lines.text: 왕과 왕비는 잠든 공주님을 침실 침대에 눕혔어요.
lines.en: The king and queen laid the sleeping princess on her bed.
segs: The king and queen laid the sleeping princess on her bed.

lines.text: 우리 아가, 막내 요정 말대로 백 년을 자는구나.
lines.en: My darling, just as the youngest fairy said, you will sleep a hundred years.
segs: My darling, just as the youngest fairy said, you will sleep a hundred years.

lines.text: 공주님의 침실에 온 막내 요정이 나직이 말했어요.
lines.en: The youngest fairy came to the princess’s bedroom and spoke softly.
segs: The youngest fairy came to the princess’s bedroom and spoke softly.

lines.text: 공주님이 혼자 깨면 외로울 거야. 모두 함께 자요.
lines.en: The princess would be lonely waking up alone. Let's all sleep together.
segs: The princess would be lonely waking up alone. Let's all sleep together.

lines.text: 막내 요정이 지팡이를 살랑 흔들자, 강아지도 요리사도 쿨쿨 잠들었어요.
lines.en: The youngest fairy gave her wand a little wave, and the puppy and the cook and everyone fell fast asleep, zzz.
segs: The youngest fairy gave her wand a little wave, and the puppy and the cook and everyone fell fast asleep, zzz.

lines.text: 촛불이 후 꺼지고, 성 안이 조용조용해졌어요.
lines.en: The candle went out, whoo, and the whole castle grew hushed and still.
segs: The candle went out, whoo, and the whole castle grew hushed and still.

lines.text: 촛불도 잠들고, 성 둘레에는 가시덤불이 높이높이 자랐어요.
lines.en: The candles went to sleep too, and all around the castle, a thorn hedge grew higher and higher.
segs: The candles went to sleep too, and all around the castle, a thorn hedge grew higher and higher.

lines.text: 백 년이 흘렀어요. 낮과 밤이 몇 번이나 지났을까요.
lines.en: A hundred years went by. How many days and nights passed?
segs: A hundred years went by. How many days and nights passed?

lines.text: 나무는 쑥쑥 자라고, 가시덤불은 더욱 빽빽해졌어요.
lines.en: The tree grew tall, up, up, up, and the thorn hedge grew thicker and thicker.
segs: The tree grew tall, up, up, up, and the thorn hedge grew thicker and thicker.

lines.text: 어느 날 성 밖에서, 할아버지가 찾아온 왕자에게 말했어요.
lines.en: One day outside the castle, an old man spoke to a visiting prince.
segs: One day outside the castle, an old man spoke to a visiting prince.

lines.text: 저 안에 공주님이 백 년째 자고 있대요.
lines.en: They say a princess has been sleeping in there for a hundred years.
segs: They say a princess has been sleeping in there for a hundred years.

lines.text: 제가 가 볼게요.
lines.en: I'll go and see.

lines.text: 왕자님이 다가가자 가시덤불이 스르륵 움직였어요.
lines.en: As the prince came near, the thorn hedge began to stir, rustle, rustle.
segs: As the prince came near, the thorn hedge began to stir, rustle, rustle.

lines.text: 가시덤불이 왕자님에게만 길을 열어 주었어요.
lines.en: The thorn hedge opened a path, just for the prince.
segs: The thorn hedge opened a path, just for the prince.

lines.text: 가시덤불을 지나온 왕자님은 성 안 부엌으로 들어갔어요.
lines.en: After passing through the thorns, the prince stepped into the castle kitchen.
segs: After passing through the thorns, the prince stepped into the castle kitchen.

lines.text: 쉿, 다들 자고 있어요.
lines.en: Shh, everyone is sleeping.

lines.text: 왕자님은 발소리를 죽이고 걸었어요.
lines.en: The prince walked on tiptoe, as quietly as he could.
segs: The prince walked on tiptoe, as quietly as he could.

lines.text: 탁자 아래에서는 강아지가 쿨쿨, 선반 위에서는 새가 꾸벅꾸벅 졸았어요.
lines.en: Under the table the puppy snored, zzz, and up on the shelf the bird nodded, nod, nod.
segs: Under the table the puppy snored, zzz, and up on the shelf the bird nodded, nod, nod.

lines.text: 요리사 옆에서는 꼬마 요리사가 국자를 든 채 드르렁 코를 골았어요.
lines.en: Next to the cook, the little cook snored, zzz, still holding his ladle.
segs: Next to the cook, the little cook snored, zzz, still holding his ladle.

lines.text: 왕자님은 살금살금, 공주님의 방을 찾아 올라갔어요.
lines.en: The prince crept, creep, creep, up the stairs to find the princess's room.
segs: The prince crept, creep, creep, up the stairs to find the princess's room.

lines.text: 마침내 왕자님은 공주님이 잠든 침실에 도착했어요.
lines.en: At last, the prince reached the bedroom where the princess slept.
segs: At last, the prince reached the bedroom where the princess slept.

lines.text: 왕자님은 공주님 곁에 조용히 무릎을 꿇고 기다렸어요.
lines.en: The prince knelt quietly beside the princess and waited.
segs: The prince knelt quietly beside the princess and waited.

lines.text: 바로 그때, 백 년이 꽉 찼어요. 공주님이 스스로 눈을 떴어요.
lines.en: Just then, the hundred years were up. The princess opened her eyes all by herself.
segs: Just then, the hundred years were up. The princess opened her eyes all by herself.

lines.text: 왕자님이세요? 오래 기다렸어요.
lines.en: Is that you, Prince? I've waited so long.
segs: Is that you, Prince? I've waited so long.

lines.text: 안녕하세요, 공주님.
lines.en: Hello, Princess.

lines.text: 성 안의 모두가 기지개를 켰어요.
lines.en: Everyone in the castle stretched and woke up.
segs: Everyone in the castle stretched and woke up.

lines.text: 그날 저녁 예배당에서 결혼식을 올렸지요. 이번에는 요정 여덟 명을 모두 불렀어요. 접시도 여덟 개!
lines.en: That evening they were married in the chapel. This time, all eight fairies were invited. And eight plates, too!
segs: That evening they were married in the chapel. This time, all eight fairies were invited. And eight plates, too!

lines.text: 늙은 요정도 예배당에 와서 두 사람을 축하했어요.
lines.en: The old fairy came to the chapel too, to wish them well.
segs: The old fairy came to the chapel too, to wish them well.

lines.text: 나도 불러 줘서 고마워.
lines.en: Thank you for inviting me too.
segs: Thank you for inviting me too.

lines.text: 모두 손을 흔들며 인사했어요. 안녕!
lines.en: Everyone waved and said goodbye. Bye-bye!
segs: Everyone waved and said goodbye. Bye-bye!

lines.text: 아무도 빼놓지 않아야 해요. 잊힌 사람의 마음은 아프답니다.
lines.en: Never leave anyone out. Being forgotten makes a heart ache.
segs: Never leave anyone out. Being forgotten makes a heart ache.
